clue.text: Resort not for elite with time off

parts.note: someone not for an idea is against it, anti

indicators.note: off says the letter for time is dropped from the word for elite

parts.note: the elite are the best

explanation.surface: A holiday resort that turns away the upper crust and gives everyone time off.
explanation.walkthrough: 'off' removes T from BEST, leaving BES.
explanation.definitionFit: Antibes is a well-known seaside town on the French Riviera, a holiday spot.

clue.text: Article on psychic ability rising in part of church

parts.note: a is the indefinite article

indicators.note: rising in a down clue says the word goes up, so it is read backwards

parts.note: ESP is extrasensory perception

explanation.surface: A newspaper piece about paranormal powers growing within a church.
explanation.walkthrough: 'rising' turns ESP upwards to PSE, placed under A in the down light.
explanation.definitionFit: An apse is the semicircular recess at the east end of a church.

clue.text: Disloyalty in partner's heart and mind

indicators.note: heart says take the central letter of the next word

parts.note: reason is the mind's faculty of thought

explanation.surface: Betrayal lodged in the core of a spouse's thoughts.
explanation.walkthrough: The heart of PARTNER is its middle letter, T.
explanation.definitionFit: Treason is betrayal of one's country, the gravest kind of disloyalty.

clue.text: Sweet bloom's been regularly pruned

indicators.note: regularly pruned says every other letter is cut away from the words before it

explanation.surface: A flower in the garden has been trimmed at intervals and smells lovely.
explanation.walkthrough: Taking the 1st, 3rd, 5th letters and so on of BLOOMS BEEN leaves BOMBE.
explanation.definitionFit: A bombe is a dome-shaped frozen dessert, a sweet in the British sense of pudding.

clue.text: Avoids upset, involving companion in plan

indicators.note: involving says the reversed word takes the companion's letters within it
upset in a down clue turns the word upside down, so it is read backwards

parts.note: eludes means avoids
CH is a Companion of Honour

explanation.surface: Someone steers clear of trouble by bringing a friend into the arrangement.
explanation.walkthrough: 'upset' looks like an anagram signal, but in a down light it turns the word upside down; 'involving' then wraps it round the companion.
explanation.definitionFit: A schedule is a timetable or plan of what is to be done when.

clue.text: Fancy better cereal

parts.note: to cap something is to better or top it
rice is a cereal grain

explanation.surface: A breakfast advertisement claiming a superior cereal.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Fancy' looks like an adjective describing the cereal, but it is the noun meaning a whim.
explanation.definitionFit: A caprice is a sudden whim, the same as a passing fancy.

clue.text: Rubbing along top of wall

definitions.meaning: to rub along is to manage or get by
the sloping top course of a wall

explanation.definitionFit: Coping means managing, and coping is also the capping course along a wall.

clue.text: Chief showing up at manor after renovation

indicators.note: after renovation says the letters of the words before it are rebuilt in a new order

explanation.surface: The lord of the manor arrives once the house has been done up.
explanation.walkthrough: 'after renovation' rearranges UPATMANOR.
explanation.definitionFit: Paramount means supreme or foremost, the same as chief.

clue.text: Royal follower filling in word of gratitude

indicators.note: filling says the follower's word goes into the middle of the pieces around it

parts.note: taken as written
ta is a British informal word for thank you
a fan is a follower or supporter

explanation.surface: A loyal subject of the crown fills in a thank-you note.
explanation.walkthrough: 'filling' sets the follower between the two pieces either side of it; TA is British informal thanks.
explanation.definitionFit: An infanta is a daughter of the king of Spain or Portugal, a royal princess.

clue.text: Learner below most of team set about new test suitable for beginner

indicators.note: below in a down clue puts the learner's letter under everything else
about says the trimmed team word goes round the other pieces
most of says the team word loses its last letter

parts.note: a cricket or football team is an eleven
a try is a test or attempt
L is a learner, as on British L-plates

explanation.surface: A trainee joins a squad set to take a fresh examination pitched at novices.
explanation.walkthrough: 'most of' trims the team word to ELEVE, and 'about' wraps that round the new test, giving ENTRYLEVE; 'set' is only a link.
explanation.definitionFit: Entry-level describes the lowest grade of a job or product, the one for newcomers.

clue.text: Tramp, say, emerging from mist as he shuffled by quietly

indicators.note: shuffled says the letters of the three words before it are rearranged like cards

parts.note: P (piano) is the musical marking for quietly

explanation.surface: A vagrant appearing out of the fog, moving with a shuffle and making no noise.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Tramp' looks like a vagrant, but a tramp is also a cargo ship with no fixed route; 'say' marks it as an example. 'shuffled' rearranges MISTASHE into STEAMSHI.
explanation.definitionFit: A tramp steamer is an example of a vessel driven by steam, picking up cargo wherever it can.

clue.text: Official in game appeal to prepare for employment again

parts.note: a ref, the referee, is the official in a game such as football
it is old slang for sex appeal

explanation.surface: A referee in a match making an appeal to be taken on once more.
explanation.walkthrough: IT for sex appeal is a crossword convention from the 1920s 'It girl'.
explanation.definitionFit: To refit a ship or building is to make it ready for service again.

clue.text: Agent keeping close beside his boss, perhaps, one making allowance

indicators.note: keeping says the agent's word holds the other pieces inside it

parts.note: a spy is a secret agent
a close is an ending
M is James Bond's boss in the spy stories, so the agent's boss
taken as written

explanation.surface: A secret agent stays near his chief and is the one who hands out the pocket money.
explanation.walkthrough: 'keeping' sets the other pieces between the agent's P and Y. 'one making' looks like part of the definition, but 'making' just links.
explanation.definitionFit: Spending money is a small sum given for personal use, such as a child's weekly allowance.

clue.text: Bachelor led by enchantress to divide loot in uneven way

indicators.note: divide says the following word is split by the pieces before it

parts.note: to sack a town is to loot it

indicators.note: led by puts the enchantress's word in front of the bachelor's letter

parts.note: a witch is an enchantress

explanation.surface: A single man under a sorceress's spell shares out the plunder unfairly.
explanation.walkthrough: 'uneven way' looks like an unfair manner of dividing, but it is a road, a switchback.
explanation.definitionFit: A switchback is a road or track with many sharp bends and ups and downs.

clue.text: Misfortune after success with dam losing a generator

indicators.note: after puts the word for misfortune behind the other pieces

parts.note: a win is a success

indicators.note: losing says the letter A is dropped from the word dam

parts.note: ill can mean misfortune, as in 'for good or ill'

explanation.surface: A run of bad luck follows a triumph when a reservoir wall gives way.
explanation.walkthrough: 'losing a' takes the A out of DAM, leaving DM.
explanation.definitionFit: A windmill harnesses the wind and so generates power, a kind of generator.

clue.text: Bit of hardware? Right to stop comic being silly with it

indicators.note: to stop says the letter for right plugs the word comic
being silly says the letters are larked about into a new order

parts.note: hip means fashionable, with it

explanation.surface: A gadget review: a comedian goofs around and calls it trendy.
explanation.walkthrough: 'to stop' puts R into COMIC, and 'being silly' rearranges those letters into MICROC. The question mark marks the definition as an example.
explanation.definitionFit: A microchip is a small piece of semiconductor circuitry, a component of computer hardware.

clue.text: Vocal tone, dominant kind

indicators.note: Vocal says the words before the definition are to be spoken out loud

parts.note: a hue is a tone of colour and main means dominant, so the pair says hue main

explanation.surface: A singing voice described in terms of its strongest, most characteristic quality.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Vocal' looks like it describes a tone of voice, but it signals a sound-alike: 'hue main' said out loud.
explanation.definitionFit: Humane means compassionate, which is what kind means when describing a person.

clue.text: Humour and energy in group declined

parts.note: wit is humour

indicators.note: in says the energy letter goes inside the word for group

parts.note: a herd is a group of animals
E is the symbol for energy

explanation.surface: A lively, witty crowd lost its spark.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in' puts E inside HERD, giving HERED.
explanation.definitionFit: Withered means shrivelled and faded, so declined in vigour.

clue.text: Banker receiving name brought about by hard depression

indicators.note: brought about, as a ship is turned round, says the pieces before it are read backwards
receiving says the banker's word takes the letter for name inside it

parts.note: in betting a banker is a certainty, a cert
H is the pencil-grading abbreviation for hard

explanation.surface: A banker, given a name, finds his good fortune turns into a hard slump.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Banker' suggests a river or a financier, but it is a betting cert. 'receiving' makes CNERT, and 'brought about' turns it to TRENC.
explanation.definitionFit: A trench is a long narrow ditch, a depression dug in the ground.

clue.text: Fencing I preserve, climbing and working

indicators.note: climbing in a down clue says the words before it are read upwards, backwards

parts.note: to save is to preserve
on means working, as a machine that is on

explanation.surface: A fencer saves the day, scaling the wall and still in action.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Fencing' looks like the sport, but it means dodging awkward questions. 'climbing' turns I SAVE into EVASI.
explanation.definitionFit: Evasion is avoiding a direct answer, which is what fencing with a questioner means.

clue.text: Purified liquid turning sour? There's row about that

indicators.note: about says the word for row goes round the other piece

parts.note: a file is a row or line, as in single file

indicators.note: turning says the word for sour is read backwards

parts.note: tart means sour

explanation.surface: An argument over whether a strained drink has gone off.
explanation.walkthrough: 'turning' reverses the sour word to TRAT before 'about' wraps the row word round it. 'row' is a line, not a quarrel.
explanation.definitionFit: A filtrate is the liquid that has passed through a filter, cleared of solids.

clue.text: Simple saint before getting crown of gold

indicators.note: getting crown of puts the gold symbol on top of the down light

parts.note: Au is the chemical symbol for gold
ere means before

explanation.surface: A humble saint is honoured with a golden crown.
explanation.walkthrough: In a down light the crown is the top, so the gold symbol sits above the other pieces.
explanation.definitionFit: Austere means plain and without adornment, so simple.

clue.text: Get stronger place of confinement south of river

indicators.note: south of in a down clue puts the pen below the river

parts.note: the Dee is a river in Britain
a pen is an enclosure for animals

explanation.surface: Building a stronger prison downstream of a river.
explanation.walkthrough: The Dee is a river in Scotland and on the English-Welsh border.
explanation.definitionFit: To deepen is to intensify, as a feeling or colour does when it grows stronger.

clue.text: Eve has led hero astray completely

indicators.note: astray says the letters of the words before it wander into a new order

explanation.surface: Eve led a heroic man off the right path, a tale of temptation.
explanation.walkthrough: 'astray' rearranges the thirteen letters of EVE HAS LED HERO.
explanation.definitionFit: Head over heels is an idiom meaning totally, as in being utterly in love.

clue.text: Cut up over court's demand

indicators.note: over in a down clue puts the reversed word above the court's letters
up in a down clue says the word is read upwards, so backwards

parts.note: to axe is to cut
CT is the abbreviation for court

explanation.surface: Someone angry at the court's ruling.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Cut up' looks like upset, but 'up' turns AXE into EXA.
explanation.definitionFit: To exact a payment is to demand and obtain it.

clue.text: Wait for support

definitions.meaning: a prop or support, as in a ship's rope or a corset

explanation.definitionFit: Stay means remain, and a stay is also a supporting brace or rope.

clue.text: Stupid chap is hugging bears

indicators.note: bears says the run of words carries the answer within it

explanation.surface: A dim-witted fellow is embracing some bears.
explanation.walkthrough: 'bears' looks like the animals, but it means carries: the words chAP IS Hugging carry the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: Apish means foolishly imitative, so silly or stupid.

clue.text: Enduring exercises with fellow in charge

parts.note: PE is physical education, school exercises

indicators.note: in says the word for fellow goes inside the word for charge

parts.note: rent is a charge paid for a property
a man is a fellow

explanation.surface: A man in authority puts people through a gruelling workout.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in charge' looks like a phrase meaning responsible, but 'in' is the container signal and charge is a payment.
explanation.definitionFit: Something permanent lasts indefinitely, so it is lasting or enduring.

clue.text: Family doctor? Popular person with vital role

parts.note: kin are family
a GP is a general practitioner, a family doctor
in means popular or fashionable

explanation.surface: A much-liked family doctor is central to the community.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Family doctor?' looks like a unit, but the two words give KIN and GP separately.
explanation.definitionFit: A kingpin is the most important person in a group, the one everything depends on.

clue.text: Uncertain inspector with speculation excluding nothing

parts.note: DI is a Detective Inspector

indicators.note: excluding says the letter for nothing is left out of the word for speculation

parts.note: a theory is speculation
O, the figure zero, means nothing

explanation.surface: A police inspector unsure of himself refuses to speculate on nothing.
explanation.walkthrough: 'excluding nothing' drops O from THEORY, leaving THERY.
explanation.definitionFit: Dithery describes someone hesitant and indecisive, unable to make up their mind.
